name: Gearleaf Forest
description: A forest where towering leaves are forged from brass gears and cogs, turning slowly in the breeze to create melodic sounds.
prompt: Enchanted forest path lined with large gear‑shaped leaves made of polished brass, their teeth interlocking as they turn, wind whistling through, golden sunlight dappled, magical realism.
caption: Nature meets clockwork—leaves that spin and sing. 🌿⚙️
